title: Luyện nghe Part 2–4 · Đề 02
description: Đề luyện nghe 42 câu Part 2–4 chủ đề văn phòng, nhân sự, tài chính và IT, độ khó khoảng 700–800, có 2 câu đọc biểu đồ.

groups.transcript:
Where should I submit my reimbursement forms?
(A) About two hundred dollars.
(B) Yes, I formed a new team.
(C) To Ms. Chen in accounting.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Where' (nộp ở đâu) → trả lời nơi/người nhận 'To Ms. Chen in accounting' (C). (A) nói số tiền, (B) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh- và lặp âm 'form'.

groups.transcript:
When is the new payroll system going live?
(A) In the payroll office.
(B) A live demonstration.
(C) It's been pushed back to April.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'When' → đáp gián tiếp: hệ thống bị lùi sang tháng Tư 'pushed back to April' (C). (A) trả lời nơi chốn, (B) lặp từ 'live'.

groups.transcript:
Who's interviewing the candidates for the analyst position?
(A) The position was posted online.
(B) Mr. Patel and two managers from finance.
(C) Yes, at ten o'clock.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Who' (ai phỏng vấn) → 'Mr. Patel and two managers from finance' (B). (A) lặp từ 'position', (C) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh-.

groups.transcript:
Why is the printer on the third floor out of service?
(A) Its paper tray is broken.
(B) On the second floor.
(C) Three copies, please.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Why' (vì sao máy in hỏng) → nêu lý do 'Its paper tray is broken' (A). (C) gần âm 'three/third', (B) trả lời nơi chốn.

groups.transcript:
How long will the software update take?
(A) Yes, it's up to date.
(B) I'd rather take the train.
(C) About twenty minutes.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'How long' (bao lâu) → khoảng thời gian 'About twenty minutes' (C). (B) lặp từ 'take', (A) trả lời Yes và lặp âm 'update/up to date'.

groups.transcript:
Which spreadsheet has the updated budget figures?
(A) Sure, I'll update it.
(B) The one Kevin sent this morning.
(C) The budget meeting is on Friday.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Which' (bảng tính nào) → 'The one Kevin sent this morning' (B). (A) lặp 'update' và không trả lời câu hỏi, (C) lặp 'budget' nhưng nói về cuộc họp.

groups.transcript:
Have you finished reviewing the job applications?
(A) I still have about ten left.
(B) An application form.
(C) She finished first.

questions.explanation: Câu Yes/No hỏi đã xem xong hồ sơ chưa → đáp gián tiếp 'chưa, còn khoảng mười bộ' (A). (B) lặp 'application', (C) lặp 'finished' nhưng sai chủ ngữ.

groups.transcript:
Isn't the IT department moving to the new building?
(A) The building manager.
(B) Move it to the left.
(C) Only the help desk staff.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định → đáp gián tiếp: chỉ nhân viên help desk chuyển đi (C). (A) lặp 'building', (B) lặp 'move'.

groups.transcript:
Do you know if the quarterly report has been approved?
(A) The director is still reviewing it.
(B) I approve of the new design.
(C) Every three months.

questions.explanation: Hỏi báo cáo quý đã được duyệt chưa → 'giám đốc vẫn đang xem' tức là chưa (A). (C) liên tưởng 'quarterly', (B) lặp 'approve'.

groups.transcript:
You've met our new accounting manager, haven't you?
(A) Yes, the meeting was moved.
(B) Our account number is on the invoice.
(C) No, but I'm having lunch with her tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi hỏi đã gặp quản lý kế toán mới chưa → 'chưa, nhưng mai tôi ăn trưa với cô ấy' (C). (B) gần âm 'accounting/account', (A) gần âm 'met/meeting'.

groups.transcript:
Should we hold the training session online or in the conference room?
(A) It holds about forty people.
(B) Several employees are working from home that week.
(C) Yes, the session was useful.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (trực tuyến hay phòng họp) → đáp gián tiếp: nhiều người làm ở nhà tuần đó, nên tổ chức trực tuyến (B). (C) trả lời Yes cho câu lựa chọn, (A) lặp 'hold'.

groups.transcript:
Would you like the report printed or sent by e-mail?
(A) Yes, I'd like that.
(B) An electronic copy is fine.
(C) I reported it yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (in hay gửi e-mail) → 'bản điện tử là được' = gửi e-mail (B). (C) gần âm 'report', (A) trả lời Yes cho câu lựa chọn.

groups.transcript:
Could you help me set up the projector before the presentation?
(A) He's setting the table.
(B) Sure, I'll be there in five minutes.
(C) It was a good presentation.

questions.explanation: Lời nhờ giúp lắp máy chiếu → đồng ý 'Sure, I'll be there in five minutes' (B). (C) lặp 'presentation' nhưng sai thì, (A) gần âm 'set up/setting'.

groups.transcript:
Why don't we ask Ms. Garcia to lead the budget review?
(A) She's on vacation until next week.
(B) Because the budget was approved.
(C) The review was positive.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't we…' là lời đề nghị, không hỏi lý do → đáp gián tiếp: cô ấy nghỉ phép đến tuần sau (A). (B) bẫy trả lời 'Because', (C) lặp 'review'.

groups.transcript:
The new laptops for the sales team arrived this morning.
(A) Great, I'll start setting them up.
(B) The sales figures are higher.
(C) No, I'll arrive tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Câu trần thuật báo laptop mới đã đến → phản hồi hợp lý 'tôi sẽ bắt đầu cài đặt' (A). (B) lặp 'sales', (C) lặp 'arrive'.

groups.transcript:
W: Hi, Daniel. It's Rachel from human resources. I'm calling about the receptionist position you asked us to fill.
M: Thanks, Rachel. Have you found anyone yet? Our current receptionist leaves at the end of the month.
W: We've narrowed it down to two candidates. Both have strong customer service experience, but one of them also speaks Japanese.
M: That would be really helpful. We get a lot of calls from our Tokyo office.
W: I thought so. Would you be available to interview her on Thursday afternoon?
M: I have a client meeting until three, but I'm free after that.
W: Great. I'll schedule the interview for three thirty and send you her résumé right away.

questions.content: Where does the woman most likely work?
options: In a customer service call center
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ tự giới thiệu 'It's Rachel from human resources' → (B). Các nơi khác chỉ là từ liên tưởng (tiếng Nhật, dịch vụ khách hàng).

questions.content: What does the man say about his company?
options: It is opening a branch in Tokyo.
It is moving at the end of the month.
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông nói 'We get a lot of calls from our Tokyo office' → thường nhận cuộc gọi từ văn phòng khác (D). Công ty không mở chi nhánh (B); lễ tân hiện tại sắp nghỉ chứ không phải mới tuyển (A).

questions.content: What will the woman do next?
questions.explanation: Cuối hội thoại: 'send you her résumé right away' → gửi tài liệu (hồ sơ) cho người đàn ông (A).

groups.transcript:
M: Linda, do you have a minute? I'm going over the invoice from Brightline Office Supplies, and the total seems high.
W: Let me see. They charged us for fifty boxes of printer paper, but we only ordered thirty.
M: That's what I thought. Should I call them, or would you like to handle it?
W: Honestly, I'm buried in the quarterly tax filings this week.
M: No problem, I'll take care of it. Do you know who our contact there is?
W: Yes, it's Mark Fischer. His number is in the vendor database. Ask him to send a corrected invoice before we process the payment.

questions.content: What problem does the man mention?
options: A product is out of stock.
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông nói hoá đơn 'the total seems high', người phụ nữ xác nhận bị tính 50 hộp thay vì 30 → tổng tiền hoá đơn sai (B).

questions.content: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'm buried in the quarterly tax filings this week"?
options: She will finish the filings by today.
She would like help with the tax filings.
She is too busy to deal with the problem.
She disagrees with the man's calculation.
questions.explanation: Người đàn ông hỏi ai sẽ gọi nhà cung cấp; cô ấy nói đang ngập trong hồ sơ thuế → hàm ý quá bận, không xử lý được (C). Ngay sau đó anh ấy nhận 'I'll take care of it'.

questions.content: What does the woman ask the man to do?
questions.explanation: 'Ask him to send a corrected invoice before we process the payment' → yêu cầu hoá đơn đã sửa (D). Cô ấy dặn chưa thanh toán nên (C) sai.

groups.transcript:
W1: Thanks for coming, everyone. As you know, we're switching to the new project management software on Monday.
M: I tried the test version last week. It's much faster than our current system, but some of the menus are confusing.
W2: That's why I've arranged two training sessions with the vendor. One is tomorrow at ten, and the other is on Friday at two.
W1: Great. Paul, could you make sure everyone on your team signs up for one of them?
M: Sure. I'll send out a reminder this afternoon.
W2: And if anyone can't attend, the vendor will also post a recording of the session on the company intranet.

questions.content: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A decision about hiring new staff
questions.explanation: Mở đầu: 'we're switching to the new project management software on Monday' → thay đổi phần mềm công ty (A).

questions.content: What does the man say about the test version?
questions.explanation: 'some of the menus are confusing' → một số phần khó hiểu (C). Anh ấy còn khen nó nhanh hơn, không nhắc cài đặt hay giá.

questions.content: According to the second woman, what will be available on the intranet?
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ thứ hai: 'the vendor will also post a recording of the session on the company intranet' → bản ghi buổi đào tạo (B).

groups.transcript:
M: Hello, Ms. Okafor. This is Sam Lee from Westbrook Consulting. I'm calling about our meeting next Tuesday to review your company's budget plan.
W: Hi, Sam. Is there a problem?
M: I'm afraid my flight back from Singapore has been delayed, so I won't be in the office until Wednesday. Could we move the meeting to Thursday morning?
W: Thursday morning works for me. But my finance director wants to join, and he's only free after eleven.
M: Then how about eleven thirty? I could bring lunch for everyone.
W: That sounds perfect. I'll reserve the large conference room on the fifth floor.

questions.content: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation: Anh ấy gọi về cuộc họp thứ Ba và hỏi 'Could we move the meeting to Thursday morning?' → dời lịch họp (C).

questions.content: Why is the man unable to meet on Tuesday?
options: His return trip has been delayed.
He has not finished a report.
questions.explanation: 'my flight back from Singapore has been delayed' → chuyến về bị hoãn (A), diễn đạt lại 'flight back' thành 'return trip'.

questions.content: What does the man offer to do?
questions.explanation: 'I could bring lunch for everyone' → cung cấp bữa ăn (D). Đặt phòng họp là việc người phụ nữ làm (A).

groups.transcript:
W: Excuse me, I'm starting in the accounting department today, and I'm here for the orientation. Am I in the right place?
M: Yes, welcome! The overview session in this room is about to begin. Did you get a copy of the schedule?
W: I did, thanks. But I have a question. I was told to bring my bank details for the payroll session, and I left them at home.
M: That's fine. You can submit that information online by the end of the week.
W: Oh, good. And will the IT session cover how to access the accounting software?
M: Not exactly. They'll set up your e-mail and network account. Your supervisor will give you access to the accounting software later.

questions.content: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: 'I'm starting in the accounting department today, and I'm here for the orientation' → nhân viên mới (B).

questions.content: Look at the graphic. In which room will the woman discuss her payroll information?
questions.explanation: Cô ấy nhắc 'the payroll session'; theo lịch, buổi Benefits & Payroll diễn ra ở Room 305 → (C).

questions.content: According to the man, who will give the woman access to the accounting software?
questions.explanation: 'Your supervisor will give you access to the accounting software later' → người giám sát của cô ấy (D). Bộ phận IT chỉ cài e-mail và mạng (C).

groups.transcript: Hello, this message is for Gina Romano. This is Victor from the IT help desk returning your call about your laptop. I understand that it's been shutting down unexpectedly whenever you open large spreadsheets. Based on what you described, the problem is most likely the battery, which is over four years old. We have replacement batteries in stock, so I can install a new one today. The repair takes about thirty minutes, but you'll need to back up your files first, just in case. Please bring the laptop to our office on the second floor any time before five. If that's not convenient, call me back at extension two-two-one-six and we'll find another time.

questions.content: What problem does the speaker mention?
questions.explanation: 'it's been shutting down unexpectedly' → máy tính tự tắt bất ngờ (B). 'spreadsheets' chỉ là lúc lỗi xảy ra, không phải bảng tính bị lỗi (A).

questions.content: What does the speaker ask the listener to do before the repair?
questions.explanation: 'you'll need to back up your files first' → sao lưu (lưu bản sao) tệp (A). Pin đã có sẵn trong kho nên không cần mua (B).

questions.content: According to the speaker, what is the likely cause of the problem?
questions.explanation: 'the problem is most likely the battery, which is over four years old' → pin cũ (B).

groups.transcript: Good evening, and welcome to the third session of our Small Business Finance series. Tonight's speaker is Dr. Helen Park, who has advised hundreds of start-up companies on managing cash flow. Dr. Park's book on budgeting for new businesses was published last spring, and it's already in its fourth printing. That tells you something. After her talk, Dr. Park will take questions from the audience, so please write yours on the cards that were handed out at the entrance. Copies of her book are also available at the table in the back, and she's kindly agreed to sign them at the end of the evening.

questions.content: What is the topic of the seminar series?
questions.explanation: 'our Small Business Finance series' → quản lý tài chính cho doanh nghiệp nhỏ (A).

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, "That tells you something"?
options: To ask the audience for feedback
To show that a book sells well
questions.explanation: Ngay trước đó: sách xuất bản mùa xuân năm ngoái đã in lần thứ tư → câu nói hàm ý cuốn sách rất được ưa chuộng (D).

questions.content: What are listeners asked to do?
options: Sign up for the next session
questions.explanation: 'please write yours on the cards that were handed out at the entrance' → viết câu hỏi lên thẻ (A). 'entrance' chỉ là nơi phát thẻ (C).

groups.transcript: Before we wrap up today's staff meeting, I have an update about business travel. Starting next month, all travel expenses will be submitted through our new online system instead of on paper forms. The system automatically checks receipts against company policy, so reimbursements should be processed within five business days rather than three weeks. To help everyone get used to it, the finance team will hold a short demonstration this Thursday at two in the main conference room. If you have any trips planned for next month, please book them through our approved travel agency, because the system will only accept bookings made there. I'll e-mail you the agency's contact details after the meeting.

questions.content: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To introduce a new expense system
To reschedule the next staff meeting
questions.explanation: Nội dung chính: chi phí công tác sẽ nộp qua 'our new online system' → giới thiệu hệ thống chi phí mới (B).

questions.content: According to the speaker, what benefit will the change bring?
questions.explanation: 'reimbursements should be processed within five business days rather than three weeks' → hoàn tiền nhanh hơn (C).

questions.content: What will the speaker send after the meeting?
questions.explanation: 'I'll e-mail you the agency's contact details after the meeting' → thông tin liên hệ của đại lý (C).

groups.transcript: Thanks for joining this quick meeting. I've put up a chart showing the average number of calls our help desk received each day last month. As you can see, demand varies quite a bit across the week. To reduce wait times, management has approved hiring a part-time technician, who will work only on our busiest day. Interviews start next week. In the meantime, I'd like to try something else. Many of our calls are about resetting passwords, so I've asked Kenji to write a short guide that employees can follow on their own. He'll post it on the intranet by Wednesday. If it works, it should cut the number of calls significantly.

questions.content: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.explanation: Người nói trình bày số cuộc gọi 'our help desk received' và cách giảm thời gian chờ → người nghe là nhân viên bộ phận hỗ trợ (D).

questions.content: Look at the graphic. On which day will the part-time technician work?
questions.explanation: Kỹ thuật viên bán thời gian 'will work only on our busiest day'; theo biểu đồ, thứ Sáu có nhiều cuộc gọi nhất (140) → (D).

questions.content: What will Kenji do by Wednesday?
questions.explanation: Kenji viết hướng dẫn tự đặt lại mật khẩu và 'He'll post it on the intranet by Wednesday' → đăng hướng dẫn lên mạng nội bộ (C).
